Amazon Aurora.description: AWS's managed relational database, compatible with MySQL and PostgreSQL.
Amazon Aurora.bestFor: Transactional apps on AWS with light analytics

Amazon EMR.description: AWS managed service for running Apache Spark and other open-source big-data engines.
Amazon EMR.bestFor: Running Spark jobs on AWS without managing the cluster software

Amazon Redshift.description: AWS's managed columnar cloud data warehouse, provisioned or serverless.
Amazon Redshift.bestFor: SQL warehousing and BI for teams already on AWS

Apache DataFusion Comet.description: Open-source Spark plugin that runs Spark SQL on native DataFusion operators.
Apache DataFusion Comet.bestFor: Faster open-source Spark you tune yourself

Apache Gluten.description: Spark plugin that offloads Spark SQL to native engines such as Velox and ClickHouse.
Apache Gluten.bestFor: Speeding up existing Spark SQL jobs on a native backend

Apache Doris.description: Open-source MPP analytical database with real-time ingestion and MySQL-compatible SQL.
Apache Doris.bestFor: Real-time dashboards and reports with many concurrent users

Apache Druid.description: Open-source real-time analytics database with streaming ingestion and pre-aggregation.
Apache Druid.bestFor: Sub-second slice-and-dice dashboards on streaming event data

Apache Hudi.description: Open lakehouse table format with record-level upserts, deletes and incremental pulls.
Apache Hudi.bestFor: Streaming upserts and CDC into a data lake

Apache Spark.description: Open-source distributed engine for batch SQL, streaming and machine learning.
Apache Spark.bestFor: Large-scale ETL and batch processing across a cluster

CedarDB.description: PostgreSQL-compatible database for transactions and analytics, built on the Umbra research system.
CedarDB.bestFor: Running analytics directly on live PostgreSQL-style data

ClickHouse.description: Open-source column-oriented OLAP database built for very fast scans and aggregations.
ClickHouse.bestFor: Real-time analytics on huge event and log tables

Dask.description: Python library that scales pandas, NumPy and custom code across cores or a cluster.
Dask.bestFor: Scaling existing Python data workflows beyond one machine

DataFusion.description: Extensible query engine in Rust built on Apache Arrow, used as a library.
DataFusion.bestFor: Embedding a fast SQL engine in your own data product

Databricks.description: Managed lakehouse platform built on Spark, Delta Lake and the Photon engine.
Databricks.bestFor: Unified data engineering, SQL and ML on a lakehouse

Delta Lake.description: Open table format that adds ACID transactions and time travel to Parquet data lakes.
Delta Lake.bestFor: Reliable, versioned tables on object storage

DuckDB.description: In-process analytical SQL database; no server, runs inside your app or notebook.
DuckDB.bestFor: Fast local analytics on files (Parquet, CSV) on one machine

Exasol.description: In-memory, massively parallel columnar analytics database.
Exasol.bestFor: Fast BI and reporting queries at high concurrency

Google BigQuery.description: Google Cloud's serverless, pay-per-query data warehouse.
Google BigQuery.bestFor: Ad-hoc SQL on very large data with no infrastructure to run

HEAVY.AI.description: GPU-accelerated columnar SQL database (formerly OmniSci and MapD) that also runs on CPUs.
HEAVY.AI.bestFor: Interactive geospatial and time-series analytics on GPUs

Kinetica.description: GPU-accelerated analytical database with strong geospatial and time-series support.

LakeSail.description: Makers of Sail, a Rust engine on DataFusion that is a drop-in replacement for Spark.
LakeSail.bestFor: Running existing Spark SQL and DataFrame code without the JVM

Microsoft Fabric.description: Microsoft SaaS analytics platform with a SQL warehouse over OneLake Delta tables.
Microsoft Fabric.bestFor: Microsoft-centric teams unifying warehousing, lakehouse and Power BI

Modin.description: Drop-in replacement for pandas that parallelizes operations across all cores.
Modin.bestFor: Speeding up pandas code without rewriting it

MonetDB.description: Open-source column-store database that pioneered vectorized, in-memory query execution.
MonetDB.bestFor: In-memory analytics and research on a single server

MySQL HeatWave.description: Oracle's managed MySQL service with an in-memory, massively parallel query accelerator.
MySQL HeatWave.bestFor: Analytics on live MySQL data without a separate warehouse

Onehouse Quanton.description: Onehouse's commercial native engine for Spark, built on a Velox fork, with its own optimizer rules.
Onehouse Quanton.bestFor: Speeding up existing Spark jobs without rewriting them

Pandas.description: The standard Python DataFrame library for data manipulation and analysis.
Pandas.bestFor: Exploratory analysis of data that fits in memory

Polars.description: Fast multi-threaded DataFrame library in Rust with a lazy query optimizer.
Polars.bestFor: High-performance DataFrame work on a single machine

PostgreSQL.description: Open-source row-oriented relational database with a large extension ecosystem.
PostgreSQL.bestFor: Transactional apps that also need moderate SQL analytics

Power BI Datamart.description: Self-service managed SQL database inside Microsoft Power BI.
Power BI Datamart.bestFor: Business users building BI datasets without IT

Rockset.description: Real-time search and analytics database with converged indexing (acquired by OpenAI in 2024).
Rockset.bestFor: Low-latency queries on fresh semi-structured data

SQLite.description: Embedded row-oriented SQL database stored in a single file; no server.
SQLite.bestFor: Local application storage with light SQL analytics

SingleStore.description: Distributed SQL database combining rowstore transactions with columnstore analytics.

Snowflake.description: Managed cloud data warehouse with separate storage and elastic compute.
Snowflake.bestFor: Enterprise warehousing with easy scaling and data sharing

StarRocks.description: Open-source MPP OLAP database with a vectorized engine and lakehouse queries.
StarRocks.bestFor: Fast multi-table joins for dashboards and lakehouse analytics

Tableau Hyper.description: Tableau's in-memory SQL engine, also usable standalone via the Hyper API.
Tableau Hyper.bestFor: Fast extracts and analytics feeding Tableau

Trino.description: Open-source distributed SQL engine that queries data where it lives.
Trino.bestFor: Federated interactive SQL across lakes and databases

esProc.description: Data computing engine using its own SPL language instead of SQL.
esProc.bestFor: Complex multi-step computations that are awkward in SQL
